AN ORDINANCE FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT,GEORGIA TO PROVIDE FOR A MAXIMUM SPEED LIMIT ON ALL STREETS WITHIN THE TOWN LIMITS NOT DESIGNATED AS STATE HIGHWAYS; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALTIES AND PROCEDURES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

PURSUANT TO Section 40-6-183 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated Concerning Local Authorities power to alter lawful speed limits, the following Ordinance regulating speed limits within the Town of Clermont, Hall County, Georgia is adopted.

BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Town Council of Clermont, Hall County, Georgia that the maximum speed limit on all streets within the town limits, not designated as State Highways, shall be twenty-five Miles Per Hour (25 MPH).

BE IT RESOLVED that any person convicted of a violation of this Ordinance shall be punished as provided for by law.

ALL ORDINANCES or parts of Ordinances in conflict with this Ordinance are hereby repealed.

THIS ORDINANCE shall become effective when appropriate signs have been erected by the governing authority of Clermont, Georgia.

Adopted by the Mayor and Council for the Town of Clermont, Georgia this FAnd_ day of 7 in , 1990.
